versions.content: If it is possible to buffer a CanIf Tx L-PDU or a Transmit Request , because the buffer size of the assigned CanIfTxBuffer is bigger than zero (see [SWS_CANIF_00835]), CanIf shall buffer a CanIf Tx L-PDU or the Transmit Request in a free buffer element of the assigned CanIfTxBuffer , if the CanIf Tx L-PDU or the Transmit Request is not already buffered in the CanIfTxBuffer .
